in_sanskrit.name: Natubhai
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord of the Earth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Natubhai एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Natubhai is a compound name, consisting of two parts - 'Natu' and 'Bhai'. 'Natu' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nathu', which means 'Lord' or 'Master'. 'Bhai' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bhagavan', which means 'God' or 'Lord'. Thus, Natubhai can be translated as 'Lord of the Earth'.
